reference.description:
A mapping of provider names to provider-specific file identifiers.

Provider references allow files to be identified across different providers without re-uploading, by storing each provider's own identifier for the same logical file.

```ts {   "openai": "file-abc123",   "anthropic": "file-xyz789" } ```

The `type?: never` constraint excludes any object that has a `type` property, so a `SharedV4ProviderReference` cannot be confused with a tagged file-data shape (e.g. `{ type: 'data', data }` or `{ type: 'reference', reference }`) when both appear in the same union.

mediaType.description:
Either a full IANA media type (`type/subtype`, e.g. `image/png`) or just the top-level IANA segment (e.g. `image`, `audio`, `video`, `text`).

`*`-subtype wildcards (e.g. `image/*`) are normalized as equivalent to the top-level segment alone (e.g. `image`). Providers can use the helpers in `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` (`isFullMediaType`, `getTopLevelMediaType`, `detectMediaType`) to resolve the field according to their API requirements.

Reasoning files originate from a model's reasoning output and are always raw bytes or a fetchable URL. AutomateStreamEvent.description:
Top-level discriminated union of every event a `/v1/automate` SSE client can receive on the wire. Composes  {@link  WebAgentEvent }  (agent-loop events emitted via  {@link  WebAgentEventEmitter } ) with the stream-wrapper events (`complete`, `done`, `error`) emitted by the HTTP route handler after the agent returns.

This is the authoritative source-of-truth for downstream SDK generation. Its JSON Schema export (`schemas/automate-stream-event.json`) is consumed by tabs-api to type `/v1/automate`'s SSE response in `@tabstack/sdk`.

BrowserReconnectedEventData.description: Event data when the browser reconnects after a mid-task disconnect

endpointIndex.description: 1-based index of the CDP endpoint now in use

startingUrl.description: The original starting URL the agent is restarting execution from

total.description: Total number of configured CDP endpoints

CdpEndpointConnectedEventData.description: Event data when a CDP endpoint is successfully connected to

endpointIndex.description: 1-based index of the endpoint that connected

total.description: Total number of configured CDP endpoints

CdpEndpointCycleEventData.description: Event data when a CDP endpoint fails and the next one is being tried

attempt.description: 1-based index of the endpoint attempt that failed

error.description: Sanitized error identifier from the failed connection attempt (error.name, not error.message — full messages may contain endpoint URLs)

total.description: Total number of configured CDP endpoints

CompressionDebugEventData.description: Event data for compression debug info

FormFieldRequest.description: A single form field the agent needs data for.

currentValue.description: Current value if already partially filled

description.description: Additional context (e.g., validation error message on re-request)

ref.description: Element ref from the accessibility tree (e.g., "E42")

required.description: Whether this field must be filled

InteractiveFormDataErrorEventData.description: Event data when form validation fails and the agent re-requests data. Carries both the error context and the fields that need new values. Callers respond to this the same way as a request event.

fieldErrors.description: Per-field error messages from validation (field ref -> error text)

InteractiveFormDataRequestEventData.description: Event data when the agent requests user data for form fields

MessagesDebugEventData.description: Event data for message debug info

PageNavigationEventData.description: Event data when navigating to a page

ProcessingEventData.description: Event data for when the agent is waiting for model generation

ScreenshotCapturedImageEventData.description: Event data for screenshot image capture with full image data This event contains the complete screenshot and can be very large

StreamCompleteEventData.description: Payload for the `complete` stream event. Structurally identical to TaskExecutionResult from webAgent.ts — the `complete` event's data is the agent's final TaskExecutionResult, stringified onto the SSE stream.

StreamDoneEventData.description: Payload for the `done` stream terminator event. Empty today; reserved for future metadata.

StreamErrorEventData.description: Payload for the top-level `error` stream event. Emitted when an uncaught error escapes the task runner. Mirrors `ErrorResponse` from the server package's `taskRunner.ts` — kept structurally aligned so schema and runtime stay consistent. Distinct from agent-level error events like `ai:generation:error` and `task:validation_error`, which are emitted through the normal event emitter during the agent loop.

TaskAbortedEventData.description: Event data when a task is aborted

TaskCompleteEventData.description: Event data when a task is completed

validationOutcome.description:
How validation resolved when a final answer was accepted:
- "accepted": validator returned complete/excellent
- "force-accepted": validator never accepted but maxValidationAttempts was hit
- undefined: validation didn't run (task aborted, max iterations, etc.)

Mirrors `TaskExecutionResult.validationOutcome`; consumers can read the outcome from this event without needing the function return value.

TaskError.description: Structured error information for failed tasks

error.description: Error details when success is false

finalAnswer.description: Final answer or result from the agent

validationOutcome.description:
How validation resolved when a final answer was accepted:
- "accepted": validator returned complete/excellent
- "force-accepted": validator never accepted but maxValidationAttempts was hit
- undefined: no answer was ever accepted (task aborted, max iterations, error,   or validation rejected without reaching force-accept)

TaskSetupEventData.description: Event data when a task is setup

pwCdpEndpointCount.description: Total number of CDP endpoints configured (index, not URLs)

TaskStartEventData.description: Event data when a task is started

ToolDropDebugEventData.description: Event data for tool-drop diagnostics: emitted when a provider returns more than one tool call in a single turn and the extras are dropped. The system prompt instructs the model to call exactly one tool per turn, but some providers occasionally return multiple — this event surfaces those cases so they can be observed instead of silently lost.

droppedCount.description: Number of tool calls that were dropped (returnedCount - 1).

droppedTools.description: Names of the dropped tools (in original order, excluding the first).

keptTool.description: Name of the tool that was kept (first in the provider's response).

ToolExecutionErrorEventData.description:
Event data when a tool the model invoked fails during execution.

This is distinct from AI_GENERATION_ERROR: the model generation step succeeded (it produced a valid tool call), but executing that tool failed. For browser actions the failure is also reported via BROWSER_ACTION_COMPLETED (success: false); this event covers all recoverable tool failures, including non-browser tools (search, extract) that have no browser-action event.

action.description: The action/tool name that failed, when available.

ValidationErrorEventData.description: Event data for validation errors during action response processing

WebAgentEvent.description: Union type of all event data types
